articles.title: Saab får miljardorder från FMV
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Saab får miljardorder från FMV
articles.body_text: Ukraina vill köpa 100 till 150 Jas Gripen E. Saab har fått en order från Försvarets materielverk (FMV) för fortsatta konceptstudier av framtidens stridsflyg. Ordern är värd 2,9 miljarder kronor under avtalsperioden 2026–2028, skriver Saab i ett pressmeddelande. Uppdraget är att vidareutveckla och demonstrera nya teknologier för framtida stridsflyg. Ordern bygger vidare på ett kontrakt som tecknades 2024 och 2025 och innefattar också optioner för åren 2029 och 2030.

articles.title: Inte bara billigt – ny plan för upphandling
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Inte bara billigt – ny plan för upphandling
articles.body_text: EU:s industrikommissionär Stéphane Séjourné. Arkivbild. Inte bara billigt – ny plan för upphandling Kvalitet och inte bara pris ska spela större roll i upphandlingar. Ett nytt EU-förslag är tänkt att skapa enklare regler och få fler att köpa på hemmaplan. ”Med den här reformen skär vi i byråkratin, ger offentliga uppköpare mer flexibilitet och gör det lättare för våra småföretag att konkurrera på den inre marknaden”, hävdar industrikommissionär Stéphane Séjourné i ett pressmeddelande om onsdagens förslag. Tanken är inte minst att lägga större fokus på kvaliteten på den vara eller tjänst som ska upphandlas offentligt. Utöver själva priset ska uppköpare i större grad kunna ta hänsyn till bland annat miljökrav, säkerhet och sociala villkor. En ”europeisk preferens” vägs också in – där upphandling ska kunna stoppas från länder utanför EU som inte ger EU-företag motsvarande tillträde till sina marknader.

articles.title: 5 000 bostadsrättsföreningar får straffavgift
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: 5 000 bostadsrättsföreningar får straffavgift
articles.body_text: Bostadsrättsföreningen Smyrna på Gärdet i Stockholm har i flera år stridit i domstol mot Statens fastighetsverk om markhyran. 5 000 bostadsrättsföreningar får straffavgift Cirka 5 000 bostadsrättsföreningar, eller var sjätte förening i hela landet, har fått en straffavgift av Bolagsverket. Anledningen är att de inte lämnat in sin årsredovisning i tid, det vill säga senast sju månader efter räkenskapsårets slut, skriver Borätt Forum. Regeln och straffet är nytt för i år. Blir det ytterligare försening höjs avgiften. Har föreningen inte kommit med sina siffror senast elva månader efter räkenskapsårets slut, hotar likvidation.

articles.title: Enklare för städer att säga nej till Airbnb
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Enklare för städer att säga nej till Airbnb
articles.body_text: Demonstration mot ”överturism” i Barcelona 2025. Arkivbild. Enklare för städer att säga nej till Airbnb Nya EU-regler föreslås göra det lättare för Europas länder att begränsa korttidsuthyrning av bostäder. Genom att definiera områden som utsatta för ett ”hårt bostadstryck” ska lokala och regionala myndigheter enklare kunna säga nej till att bostäder används främst för uthyrning till turister, snarare än boende, exempelvis via tjänster som Airbnb. ”Bristen på bostäder till överkomligt pris oroar många av våra EU-medborgare. Personer i samhällsviktiga yrken och studenter har inte råd att bo där de arbetar och studerar”, beklagar kommissionsordförande Ursula von der Leyen i ett pressmeddelande om onsdagens förslag. Förslaget innebär dock inga krav på att länder och städer måste agera. Avsikten är i stället främst att skapa en gemensam juridisk grund inom EU.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

Sådan ändring kommuniceras endast genom att en uppdaterad version av villkoren publiceras här. Vi rekommenderar därför att du regelbundet tar del av Användarvillkoren. Användarvillkoren gäller oavsett hur du tar del av tv4.se och inkluderar därmed även användning som t.ex. sker via appar. Du får inte heller kringgå eller försöka kringgå tekniska åtgärder mot kopiering. Du får endast använda Tv4.se för eget och privat bruk och i enlighet med vad som i övrigt gäller enligt tillämplig lag. TV4 är skyldiga att i efterhand granska och ta bort sådant användargenererat innehåll som är i strid med lag, detta i enlighet med den sk BBS lagen (Lag (1998:112) om ansvar för elektroniska anslagstavlor). articles.title: SVT Sport möter Graham Potter
articles.summary: I oktober 2025 tog engelsmannen Graham Potter över som förbundskapten för det svenska herrlandslaget i fotboll - efter att hans föregångare Jon Dahl Tomasson misslyckats med att ta Sverige direkt till fotbolls-VM. 50-årige Potter har ett förflutet som tränare för Premier League-klubbarna Brighton och Chelsea. Men för den svenska publiken är han kanske främst förknippad med sitt tränarjobb i Östersunds FK, som han tog från division 2 ända upp till allsvenskan. Så hur ska då Graham Potter vända den negativa trend som herrlandslaget befinner sig i? Har han vad som krävs för att Sverige ska ta sig till VM i sommar? Det och mycket annat frågade SVT Sports programledare André Pops honom.

articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Google to fund Finnish AI with €13bn investment and nuclear power pact
articles.summary: The US tech giant says the €13bn data centre project will create tens of thousands of jobs.
articles.body_text: Google will buy up to half the electricity produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants as part of a record €13bn (£11bn; $15bn) investment in the country's AI infrastructure, the company announced. The US tech giant said the package would fund three new data centres, expand an existing site and support energy projects to power growing demand for AI services. "This is Google's largest single investment in Europe and a testament to Finland's leadership in responsibly building AI infrastructure," the company said on Wednesday. "Google's decision is a clear testament to our strengths," Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said in a statement. As part of the deal, Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to 50% of the output from the Loviisa nuclear power plant. Earlier this week, TikTok announced a $1bn investment in Finland to build a new data centre in Kouvola, pointing to the country's "strong digital infrastructure, clean energy mix, robust data governance and skilled tech talent". Finland has emerged as an attractive location for data centres because of its cool climate, plentiful low-carbon electricity and relatively uncongested power grid. The colder temperatures can reduce the energy needed to cool facilities packed with computer servers. Technology companies are racing to secure power supplies as the AI boom drives demand for vast networks of data centres. The Google investment is expected to support more than 37,000 jobs during construction and boost Finland's GDP by €3.6bn a year, according to Google. Construction is set to take place in 2027 and 2028. "The value of the data economy extends far beyond direct investment into spurring innovation, research and development," Orpo added. "Deepening our collaboration with Google will deliver lasting benefits for both parties." Google will build new data centres in Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, while expanding its existing facility in Hamina, which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009.

articles.title: Mother demands answers, weeks after black woman found hanging from Mississippi tree
articles.summary: Her demands for information about what happened to Tasia Fortune have been echoed by shocked locals.
articles.body_text: The mother of a black woman whose body was found hanging from a tree in Jackson, Mississippi, has told the BBC she is still waiting for answers from officials more than a month later. Her demands have been echoed by a community in the southern US state that has been left shocked and angry. After weeks of silence, police on Tuesday confirmed for the first time that they were investigating the death of Tasia Fortune, 29, as a potential homicide - while clarifying that her official cause of death has yet to be confirmed. Authorities discovered Fortune's body on 3 August, hanging from a tree in the lot of an abandoned home. Local concern over her death has been heightened by the fact that the state has a dark history of racial violence and lynchings. The majority-black city has been left on edge. As the question lingers as to how Fortune died, petitions online signed by tens of thousands of people have called for more transparency, and members of US Congress have asked for federal intervention. "It's making me angry," Fortune's mother, Christy Spivey, said. "What is the hold up?" Spivey described desperate attempts to understand the status of the investigation and how multiple enquiries to police had gone unanswered. The first update she had received from authorities in weeks came in a public city meeting on Tuesday evening as Jackson Police Chief RaShall Brackney discussed the case and said the department "has been investigating this case from day one as a homicide". Brackney, in a statement to the BBC, elaborated and said the department always treats any pending death case as a "potential homicide" so that crucial evidence is not lost as police wait on autopsy results. The department, though, had only previously described the case as a death investigation. Tuesday's statement from Brackney said "we are conducting the investigation at the highest appropriate level while we await the medical examiner's findings", which would include an official cause and manner of death.

articles.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
articles.summary: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.
articles.body_text: Dozens of European royals and heads of state, including the Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings, have paid their last respects to King Harald V in Oslo. Thousands of people lined the route during a funeral procession from the royal palace to Oslo Cathedral on Wednesday afternoon, nearly two weeks after the king died aged 89. After the ceremony and burial, the Norwegian royal family, including the new King Haakon, his wife Queen Mette-Marit, and his mother and Harald's widow Queen Sonja greeted crowds from the palace balcony. A minute's silence was also observed throughout the country. Harald, who was seen as a popular, modernising figure, was on the Norwegian throne for 35 years. After 13 days of national mourning, the day began on Wednesday with ceremonial troops assembling at Akershus Fortress, the medieval castle where Harald was later laid to rest. A procession then took place, with Haakon, his sister Princess Märtha Louise and his children Crown Princess Ingrid Alexandra and Prince Sverre Magnus, following the late king's coffin on foot. Mette-Marit, who recently underwent a successful lung transplant , and Sonja, 89, followed in a car. Prince William, representing his father King Charles III , attended the funeral alongside the Princess Royal, who was there in a personal capacity as godmother to Norway's new monarch. They were among 30 royal figures from Sweden, Jordan, Monaco, Belgium, Spain, Japan and Denmark. Among the non-royal heads of state attending the funeral were Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier along with five foreign prime ministers. During the funeral service at the cathedral, Mette-Marit was seen wiping her eyes, as Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre delivered a eulogy, saying Harald had struck "a balance between being stately and down-to-earth and that he had "made Norway greater". Queen Sonja, who was also visibly emotional during the ceremony, laid a red rose on Harald's coffin.

articles.title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games
articles.summary: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.
articles.body_text: Uganda is pulling out of the Invictus Games, a sports event for wounded military veterans run by the Duke of Sussex, only two months after the country said it would join. General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, chief of defence and son of the president, made the announcement in a social media post on X. He said the decision to withdraw from the games was "in order not to be construed as being opposed to His Majesty King Charles III". Ugandan government spokesman Alan Kasujja confirmed this to the BBC: "General Kainerugaba decides whether or not the UPDF [Uganda People's Defence Force] participates in the Invictus Games. What you saw is his stated position. If it changes, he will let the world know." The Ugandan military chief's announcement follows a letter sent this week on behalf of the King which made clear that Prince Harry and Meghan, who have now returned to the UK, were not working royals. A report in The Times newspaper quoted the general's concerns about the "Harry-Meghan nonsense", suggesting this was the background to the decision. "In order not to be construed as being opposed to His Majesty King Charles III of the United Kingdom, whom we deeply revere, Uganda hereby withdraws from the Invictus Games," said the general in an overnight post. "We shall not participate in anything that does not have His Majesty's approval." However, royal sources have said that the King encourages all projects which support wounded service personnel. A spokesman for the Invictus Games said they had not received any official information about a potential withdrawal and have been seeking clarification from their contacts in Uganda. Among other posts on X from General Kainerugaba on Thursday was one that read: "I consider myself the most handsome, most daring and glorious Commander who ever lived." There was also a series of angry messages about other generals who had danced without his permission.

articles.title: White House pulls Tetris-style 'Build The Wall' game after copyright concern
articles.summary: The Tetris Company says it takes "copyright infringement very seriously" and is not involved with the game.
articles.body_text: The White House has taken down a Tetris-style game on its website called "Build The Wall", days after The Tetris Company raised concerns over its use of the game's likeness. The game, which saw players stack blocks to build a wall to "protect the border" is one of five arcade games which have appeared on the White House website. On 4 September the official Tetris account on X posted the firm was "not involved in the creation" of the game and it took "copyright infringement very seriously". The White House has not responded to requests for comment from the BBC or given an official reason for the takedown. "At Tetris we believe in the power of connection and building people together, not dividing them," the firm said in its initial response to the game. "To our fans everywhere: we love you, we see you, and we're grateful to have you in our community." The Tetris Company has had previous success in suing firms for infringing on its copyright - settling for an undisclosed fee with the makers of the iPhone game Mino in 2012, which it claimed stole the look and feel of the block-builder. Four other arcade games still remain on the mini-game section of the White House website. "Flappy Bill", a clone of the 2013 viral hit Flappy Bird sees players fly a bald eagle and dodging monuments from the National Mall. Meanwhile in Rio Run, players must "patrol the line along the river", with gameplay reminiscent of the classic phone game Snake. When players run into the edge of the map, a "Deported" number shows how many people the player was able to catch. The games have drawn criticism from politicians, with Connecticut Democratic state senator Matt Lesser tweeting : "Heating oil is near an all-time high but hey you can play Border Tsar Tom Homan in a video game".

articles.title: Germany's Merz attacks AfD in parliament after far-right election win
articles.summary: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.
articles.body_text: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has clashed with AfD leader Alice Weidel in parliament, calling her party a "destructive force" with a migration policy that amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers. Merz was addressing the Bundestag in the aftermath of the anti-immigration party's sweeping victory in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt where it won almost 44% of the vote, while the chancellor's conservatives saw their vote halved. Weidel told MPs that voters had shown that Merz's coalition with the centre left was a total failure and his time was up. Merz hit back saying the AfD had harmed German interests by backing Russia, and its "remigration" policy would affect millions. It is not yet clear whether the party will be able to form a government or not in Saxony-Anhalt, having fallen three seats short of an outright majority. No far-right party has won power in any of Germany's 16 states since World War Two, and Merz has admitted the "seismic" result has changed Germany. The AfD's success has been praised by US President Donald Trump, who said "the Populist Party in Germany just had a really big night", linking the victory to "absolutely horrible immigration rules and regulations". The AfD in Saxony-Anhalt has been labelled as "right-wing extremist" by German domestic intelligence and the party has promised a "deportation and remigration" offensive targeting irregular migrants. Trump had been due to speak by phone to the German chancellor on Wednesday to mark the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks in the US, but the government spokesman in Berlin said the call had been postponed without saying why. No new date has been set. Repeatedly heckled by AfD MPs, the chancellor told Weidel that one in six skilled workers had a migration background, and if her party had its way then its policy would amount to "nothing other than a synonym for ethnic cleansing in the skilled trades based on skin colour and origin". While the government understood some deportations were needed, he said it made a careful distinction between those who contributed to German prosperity and those without permanent residency. Disruption by AfD MPs became so loud that at one point Bundestag President Julia Klöckner threatened to start expelling people from the chamber: "We are not on a football pitch." Weidel said mass migration had left Germans with daily knife violence and attacks on trains and in stations, but Merz warned that the AfD's plans would mean that no single care home, hospital or restaurant could function.

articles.title: Colombia's new president loosens gun control rules
articles.summary: President Abelardo de la Espriella has lifted a decade-long suspension on permits to carry legal firearms.
articles.body_text: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella has signed a decree which eases restrictions on people carrying legal firearms in public. De la Espriella, who during his campaign for the presidency promised to take an iron-fist approach to crime, said it was "not right that criminals are armed to the teeth while decent people can't defend themselves". The decree lifts a suspension that had been in force for a decade, which meant that even those in possession of a permit to carry guns could not do so without additional authorisation. De la Espriella insisted that the decree would not create a free-for-all and that tight controls over who can own a gun would remain in place. While signing the decree, the president said he had made good on his campaign promise: "A man's word is his honour, and I have honour, that's why I keep my word." The restriction on carrying legal guns in public was brought in by the then-President Juan Manuel Santos in December 2015. It was originally meant to be a temporary measure, aimed at improving security during the Christmas and New Year festivities. But the suspension was extended yearly by Santos and two subsequent presidents from opposing sides of the political spectrum: conservative Iván Duque and left-wing Gustavo Petro. Under the law, even those with a permit to carry a gun could not take it out of their homes unless they applied for - and were granted - additional authorisation. De la Espriella has insisted that his decree has removed a restriction which had never been meant to be permanent. According to Spanish newspaper El País, the decree will affect almost 700,000 people in Colombia who are already in possession of a legal permit to carry a gun. They will now be able to take their registered gun out of their home, provided their permits remain up to date. Green Alliance Party Senator Ariel Ávila described the move as a "grave error", arguing that legally held guns would end up in the hands of criminals.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange strikes as two killed at Moldova border
articles.summary: Five deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes.
articles.body_text: Two people died when Russian drones hit a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said. The Starokozache crossing was shut after the overnight attack. Images from the scene show several burnt-out cars amid the debris. In Kyiv, a woman was killed and 14 people, including two children, were injured after a Russian drone hit a nine-storey building, officials said, while in Sumy three people died after a drone struck a shopping centre. In Russia, officials said four people, including a child, were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk, while a drone hit an industrial facility in the Arctic city of Novy Urengoy. In Sumy, two people were also injured in the attack on the shopping mall on Wednesday evening, regional head Oleg Grigorov said. He said efforts to deal with the aftermath were ongoing. Russia and Ukraine recently stepped up long-range strikes, despite renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war. Zelensky renewed calls for international support in the wake of the attack at the Starokozache road crossing, saying "the aggression must be stopped here and now before it spreads any further". The crossing, about 500km south of Kyiv, was shut after the attack killed two people and injured three others, Odesa regional head Oleh Kiper said. A Moldovan driver was also injured, according to the country's foreign ministry. Moldova has increasingly found itself caught up in the conflict, with Prime Minister Vasile Tofan confirming that 17 drones struck Moldovan territory in August alone - more than during the whole of last year. "Those who ignore or downplay these threats - and refuse to name the aggressor - are denying reality," he wrote on social media. "Russia started this war. Russia alone bears responsibility."

articles.title: North Korea has built a new uranium enrichment facility, says nuclear watchdog
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency's says the facility is cause for "serious concern".
articles.body_text: North Korea has built a new two-storey uranium enrichment facility, the head of the world's nuclear watchdog said this week, calling it a cause for "serious concern". The new building is part of the main Yongbyon nuclear complex, and reportedly capable of housing up to 28 centrifuge cascades used to enrich uranium. In a report published late last month, the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) said Pyongyang had also begun operating an expanded annex at another enrichment site. These findings point to a steady expansion of the North's sancitoned nuclear infrastructure. The agency, which has no inspectors in North Korea since it was expelled in 2009, relies on satellite imagery for assessments. "The continuation and further development of the DPRK's [Democratic People's Republic of Korea] nuclear programme are clear violations of relevant UN Security Council resolutions and are deeply regrettable," IAEA director Rafael Grossi said in a statement earlier this week. The IAEA first referred to the existence of the building in June, although Grossi had mentioned the possibility earlier in the year. In June, the agency said that North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited a "newly inaugurated nuclear materials production factory" on 3 June, which it identified as the Yongbyon enrichment facility. Kim had praised the country's "greatly expanded production capacity", adding that this would "offer the possibility of carrying out larger plans", according to the agency's report. Despite running one of the poorest countries in the world, Kim spends millions each year developing a secretive nuclear arsenal. A 2022 report by a non-proliferation think-tank put this figure at $640m. "What makes North Korea's nuclear programme so concerning is that many of its facilities are unknown, concealed, and thus difficult to target," Edward Howell, a lecturer at the University of Oxford told the BBC. "Beyond Yongbyon, we know that other facilities exist: Kangson, for instance. The embeddedness of North Korea's nuclear doctrine within its foreign and domestic policy means that we should expect there to be more concealed production sites." The agency also said there were indications that operations had started at another enrichment facility in Kangson, near the capital Pyongyang, in January this year. An annex had first been constructed in Kangson in 2024, it said.

articles.title: Family of murdered teen call for death penalty in D4vd trial
articles.summary: The parents of Celeste Rivas Hernandez say execution "would be perfect" if D4vd is found guilty.
articles.body_text: The family of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez has lobbied for the death penalty if D4vd is found guilty murdering their daughter. D4vd, who was born David Anthony Burke, is charged with killing the teenager, whose dismembered body was found in the trunk of a Tesla car registered to his address on 8 September 2025. Burke has pleaded not guilty to the charges. The death penalty is under a temporary ban in California, where Burke is due to stand trial, but in a statement Hernandez' family said execution "would be perfect" if the singer was convicted of murder. In a related development, Hernandez's parents filed a civil lawsuit against Burke on Friday, seeking monetary damages including burial and funeral expenses. The lawsuit, lodged at Los Angeles Superior Court and reported by multiple US media outlets , makes similar claims to those raised by prosecutors in the criminal case against the singer. Mercedes Martinez and Jesus Rivas allege that Burke caused the wrongful death, false imprisonment and childhood sexual assault of their daughter. In the court documents, they say Burke and Hernandez first met in November 2023, when she was 13 years old. Over the next 16 months, they claim, the pair would exchange almost 10,000 texts and have sex several times. "At all relevant times Burke was an adult who occupied a position of authority over decedent, a minor, and was able to and did exercise undue influence and control over her," the parents say, in papers filed last Friday. They go on to claim that Burke killed the teenager at his Hollywood Hills home, when she threatened to reveal their relationship, after allegedly sending a message that read: "I will end ur career and ur life". In addition to Burke, the lawsuit names several of Burke's companies and managers, his mother and a live-in security guard. Hernandez's parents allege that these people "enabled Burke to isolate" Rivas Hernandez and facilitated his travel, housing and security.

articles.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
articles.summary: Brent crude - the global benchmark for prices - rises after the US hit five Iranian tankers on Tuesday
articles.body_text: Oil prices rose to $100 (£74) a barrel on Wednesday, after the US and Iran attacked tankers in the Gulf region and Yemen's Houthis hit oil facilities in Saudi Arabia. Overnight, the US said it struck five Iranian tankers in retaliation for Iran's targeting of a warship, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they attacked eight tankers and two warships in response, as well as a US base in Jordan. The Guards also said they planned a new "prohibited zone" for shipping that extended beyond the Strait of Hormuz into the Arabian Sea. The Iran-backed Houthis reported dozens of Saudi strikes in Yemen, a day after drone and missile attacks caused fires at several oil facilities in Saudi Arabia. The escalating conflicts pushed the price of Brent crude, the global benchmark, to its highest level since late July, when Iran and the US resumed hostilities after a one-month lull. A barrel was priced at $100.70, up 2.83% compared to Tuesday, on Wednesday afternoon. Before the US and Israel's war with Iran began in February, Brent crude had been priced at about $70 (£52) a barrel. But Iranian missile and drone attacks on commercial shipping and a US naval blockade of Iranian ports resulted in the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz waterway in the Gulf, through which 20% of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipments usually pass. The Houthis have also been targeting Saudi energy infrastructure and tankers in the Red Sea since July, when a four-year ceasefire in Yemen began unravelling. The rising oil costs have sparked leaps in petrol prices around the world for motorists . The US military's Central Command (Centcom) said early on Wednesday that its latest strikes destroyed four Iranian oil tankers linked to Iran's Islamic Revolution Guard Corps (IRGC) in the Gulf of Oman - Kaviz, Charminar, Horizon 1 and Riesco - and a fifth tanker - Derya - near Kharg Island, in the northern Gulf, which hosts Iran's main terminal for exporting oil. US forces directed the crews to abandon ship before the vessels were struck, it added.

articles.title: US to ban imports of some Canadian alcohol, dairy goods and motorbikes
articles.summary: It is the latest strike in a long trade war, and comes after Canadian counter-tariffs on US goods come into force.
articles.body_text: The US will ban imports of a range of Canadian products, including alcoholic spirits, some dairy goods and motorbikes, after its neighbour's retaliatory tariffs on American goods came into force. In a series of executive orders on Tuesday, President Donald Trump said Canada was "discriminating" against the US and outlined the bans, which will begin on 29 September. Officials on both sides have said they would like to strike a trade deal, but no new talks have been scheduled since negotiations collapsed in late August. Dominic LeBlanc, Canada's trade minister, said the latest US measures were "unjustified" and that he would work to protect the country's workers, families and businesses. "Our core focus is on what we can control: building strength at home, diversifying our partnerships abroad, and building Canada strong for all Canadians," LeBlanc said. He said he had contacted his US counterpart and promised to work "in good faith" to resolve tensions. Earlier on Tuesday, Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney said in a video address that his country's move away from the US as its largest trading partner "will come at a cost". The White House's new sanctions are the latest strike in a months-long trade war between the US and Canada. The two countries have historically been close allies, with each a key business partner to the other. Generally more than two-thirds of Canada's total exports go to the US. In 2025, Canada's exports of alcoholic spirits to the US were worth US$687m (£507m), dairy products were worth $269m and motorbikes were worth $90m, according to UN data compiled by Trading Economics. But Stephen Brown, chief North America economist at Capital Economics, said the import ban covered just 0.25% of Canada's exports to the US. He said: "Nonetheless, Trump's willingness to impose an import ban is further evidence, if it were needed, that these latest measures are about inflicting economic pain rather than raising revenue." Canada is the second-largest trading partner of the US after Mexico. Its exports are less diversified than those of the US.

articles.title: 'Constantly on my mind' - 9/11 agony endures for bereaved, 25 years on
articles.summary: As the 25th anniversary approaches, the wait for the alleged mastermind of the attack to be put on trial goes on.
articles.body_text: The US government has described it as the "most egregious criminal act on American soil in modern history". But a quarter of a century on, the trial of its alleged mastermind is yet to begin and families of those killed fear that time for justice to be delivered is running out. Tom Resta's brother John and his wife Sylvia, who was seven months pregnant, were among the almost 3,000 people killed on 11 September 2001 when hijackers flew planes into the World Trade Center in New York City and the Pentagon in Virginia. Another crashed in a field in Pennsylvania after the passengers fought back. The couple had been preparing their unborn baby's nursery, painting it with characters from the children's television show Blue's Clues in the days before 9/11. They had dreamed of having a baby and doted on the children of friends and family. On the day of the attacks, the couple - both traders - were working on the 92nd floor of the north tower of the World Trade Center. "After all this time, it still chokes me up," Resta told the BBC through tears. While 25 years have passed, he said 9/11 was "almost constantly" on his mind. Resta has been to the US naval base of Guantanamo Bay four times to watch complex pre-trial proceedings for alleged 9/11 mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and his co-defendants - a process he describes as "laborious and tedious". A military prison was established on the base in south-eastern Cuba during the "war on terror" that followed the 9/11 attacks, and Mohammed - often referred to as KSM - has now been held there for 20 years without ever being convicted. Relatives of victims enter a lottery process to attend the proceedings in a high-security courtroom, where thick glass separates them and members of the press from the defendants. The pre-trial process has been going on for so long that it has now been presided over by five different military judges. Last month, as the 25th anniversary approached, there was a flurry of movement and something of a breakthrough, with a trial date set for Mohammed for June 2028 . But Resta said he was bracing himself for further delays, and with so much time having passed, some of his relatives feared they would not live long enough to see the trial.

articles.title: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
articles.summary: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.
articles.body_text: Israel's furious response to the British government's decision to ban trade with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank testifies to just how important this moment is. Britain took the brunt of Israel's anger, but the fact that 12 countries chose to move together clearly sharpened the sense of outrage. Officials in London always knew that such a dramatic shift in policy towards Israel-Palestine was going to elicit a hostile response, but seemed taken aback by the speed and ferocity of Israel's reaction. The closure of the UK's consulate in East Jerusalem, which serves the West Bank and deals directly with the Palestinian Authority in Ramallah, and the removal of British representatives from the International Gaza Support Centre, the body set up last year to co-ordinate stabilisation and relief efforts in the Gaza Strip, are very hostile moves. They tell you that Israel is deeply troubled by Tuesday's action by the UK and 11 other countries, which include France, Spain and Canada. Products manufactured in settlements may not represent a significant proportion of Israel's exports, but the political symbolism of singling these out for special treatment is powerful. For decades, the British and other governments have regarded settlements in occupied Palestinian territory as illegal but stopped short of banning products grown or manufactured there. Now, having announced that Britain agrees with the 2024 International Court of Justice ruling that the occupation as a whole - including Israel's military presence - is unlawful, Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband says the government's economic relationships must reflect that. Hence the ban, not just on products but also on companies that provide construction, infrastructure or finance to settlements. The measures, which also include restrictions on arms sales that "materially contribute to the occupation", go further than many expected. And it's not just the actions - it's the language of the foreign secretary's heartfelt, sometimes deeply personal statement that is so striking. As a "proud British Jew... unwavering in my support for the state of Israel," Miliband spoke more directly and starkly than practically any of his predecessors. That a British foreign secretary should say that "settler terrorism is rampant" and was responsible for the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians in parts of the West Bank, while the Israeli government "turned a blind eye to this" is truly remarkable.

articles.body_text: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. En dicha reunión, se decidirá si se permite la participación de postulantes al cargo de teniente alcalde en los debates para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 como lo ha pedido Rafael López Aliaga. Carlos Vilela, director nacional de Educación del JNE, declaró a Canal N que iniciarán el diálogo para alcanzar consensos con las agrupaciones políticas. “Buscamos de manera democrática poder decidir si ellos quieren que participe, por ejemplo, el primer candidato de la lista que postulan (...) Posiblemente se decida lo mismo, o solo se decida como en elecciones presidenciales, que solo vayan los candidatos. Eso lo vamos a saber este día lunes”. Renovación Popular ha enviado un pedido escrito al JNE para permitir la presentación de Rafael López Aliaga en el debate para la Municipalidad de Lima a pesar de que es candidato a teniente alcalde y no a la alcaldía, ya que este puesto estaba ocupado por Luis Rubio, quien renunció a su postulación. La cita técnica del lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 también servirá para definir las metodologías oficiales de los encuentros democráticos. Asimismo, los representantes partidarios elegirán a los profesionales independientes que asumirán las tareas de moderación en las transmisiones. “Nosotros invitamos a los representantes de Renovación Popular para que puedan asistir y ser partícipes del diálogo de esa propuesta”. Finalmente, Vilela exhortó al partido de López Aliaga que se sume a firmar el Pacto Ético Electoral de forma extemporánea, como lo hicieron el Partido Democrático Verde y Podemos Perú. El proceso electoral cuenta con más de 13,000 candidatos aptos para las elecciones del domingo 4 de octubre de 2026. Los debates representan un reto logístico importante para el JNE debido al alto número de postulaciones inscritas a nivel nacional. Los debates oficiales del JNE se desarrollarán de manera descentralizada desde el martes 8 de setiembre hasta el sábado 19 de setiembre de 2026. Para la Municipalidad de Lima, la exposición de propuestas quedó programada para el domingo 21 y el lunes 22 de setiembre de 2026. El cronograma electoral establece que el debate regional del Callao se realizará el miércoles 16 de setiembre de 2026. Por su parte, la región de Lima Provincias tendrá dos jornadas de diálogo democrático programadas para el jueves 17 y el viernes 18 de setiembre de 2026.

articles.summary: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. articles.body_text: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. En dicha reunión, se decidirá si se permite la participación de postulantes al cargo de teniente alcalde en los debates para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 como lo ha pedido Rafael López Aliaga. Carlos Vilela, director nacional de Educación del JNE, declaró a Canal N que iniciarán el diálogo para alcanzar consensos con las agrupaciones políticas. “Buscamos de manera democrática poder decidir si ellos quieren que participe, por ejemplo, el primer candidato de la lista que postulan (...) Posiblemente se decida lo mismo, o solo se decida como en elecciones presidenciales, que solo vayan los candidatos. Eso lo vamos a saber este día lunes”. Renovación Popular ha enviado un pedido escrito al JNE para permitir la presentación de Rafael López Aliaga en el debate para la Municipalidad de Lima a pesar de que es candidato a teniente alcalde y no a la alcaldía, ya que este puesto estaba ocupado por Luis Rubio, quien renunció a su postulación. La cita técnica del lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 también servirá para definir las metodologías oficiales de los encuentros democráticos. Asimismo, los representantes partidarios elegirán a los profesionales independientes que asumirán las tareas de moderación en las transmisiones. “Nosotros invitamos a los representantes de Renovación Popular para que puedan asistir y ser partícipes del diálogo de esa propuesta”. Finalmente, Vilela exhortó al partido de López Aliaga que se sume a firmar el Pacto Ético Electoral de forma extemporánea, como lo hicieron el Partido Democrático Verde y Podemos Perú. El proceso electoral cuenta con más de 13,000 candidatos aptos para las elecciones del domingo 4 de octubre de 2026. Los debates representan un reto logístico importante para el JNE debido al alto número de postulaciones inscritas a nivel nacional. Los debates oficiales del JNE se desarrollarán de manera descentralizada desde el martes 8 de setiembre hasta el sábado 19 de setiembre de 2026. Para la Municipalidad de Lima, la exposición de propuestas quedó programada para el domingo 21 y el lunes 22 de setiembre de 2026. El cronograma electoral establece que el debate regional del Callao se realizará el miércoles 16 de setiembre de 2026. Por su parte, la región de Lima Provincias tendrá dos jornadas de diálogo democrático programadas para el jueves 17 y el viernes 18 de setiembre de 2026.

articles.summary: Personaliza Google Discover y sigue a El Comercio para recibir en tu móvil las noticias más relevantes de Perú y el mundo.
articles.body_text: Google Discover se ha convertido en una de las formas más rápidas de mantenerse informado. Este feed de la app de Google, disponible tanto en Android como en iPhone, muestra noticias y contenidos adaptados a cada usuario según sus intereses. Con la última actualización, ahora también es posible seguir a medios de comunicación específicos, como El Comercio, para que la información más relevante del Perú y el mundo llegue directo a tu pantalla sin necesidad de buscarla. En Discover puede aparecer todo el contenido que está en el índice de Google y cumple las políticas de contenido de Discover. Para activar esta función, solo debes ingresar a Discover desde la app de Google, escribir “El Comercio” en la barra de búsqueda y seleccionar la opción de seguir. De inmediato tendrás acceso a un espacio dedicado con todas nuestras publicaciones actualizadas. También puedes hacerlo ingresando aquí. Al configurar tu feed con medios de confianza, podrás ahorrar tiempo y acceder en un solo lugar a noticias de política, economía, deportes, tecnología y cultura. Además, recibirás recomendaciones personalizadas que se ajustan a tus búsquedas y a los temas que consultas con frecuencia. En la mayoría de celulares Android, basta con deslizar hacia la izquierda en la pantalla principal para abrir Discover. En iPhone, el acceso está en la app de Google, disponible en la App Store. En ambos casos, basta con iniciar sesión con tu cuenta para empezar a personalizar tu experiencia. Así, con unos pocos pasos, puedes asegurarte de que la cobertura de El Comercio esté siempre disponible en tu feed de Discover.

articles.title: JNE: Este lunes, en reunión con partidos se evaluará si se permite que candidatos a teniente alcalde participen en debates
articles.summary: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. En dicha reunión, el organismo electoral decidirá si se permite la participación de postulantes al cargo de teniente alcalde en los debates para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 como lo ha pedido Rafael López Aliaga.
articles.body_text: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. En dicha reunión, se decidirá si se permite la participación de postulantes al cargo de teniente alcalde en los debates para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 como lo ha pedido Rafael López Aliaga. Carlos Vilela, director nacional de Educación del JNE, declaró a Canal N que iniciarán el diálogo para alcanzar consensos con las agrupaciones políticas. “Buscamos de manera democrática poder decidir si ellos quieren que participe, por ejemplo, el primer candidato de la lista que postulan (...) Posiblemente se decida lo mismo, o solo se decida como en elecciones presidenciales, que solo vayan los candidatos. Eso lo vamos a saber este día lunes”. Renovación Popular ha enviado un pedido escrito al JNE para permitir la presentación de Rafael López Aliaga en el debate para la Municipalidad de Lima a pesar de que es candidato a teniente alcalde y no a la alcaldía, ya que este puesto estaba ocupado por Luis Rubio, quien renunció a su postulación. La cita técnica del lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 también servirá para definir las metodologías oficiales de los encuentros democráticos. Asimismo, los representantes partidarios elegirán a los profesionales independientes que asumirán las tareas de moderación en las transmisiones. “Nosotros invitamos a los representantes de Renovación Popular para que puedan asistir y ser partícipes del diálogo de esa propuesta”. Finalmente, Vilela exhortó al partido de López Aliaga que se sume a firmar el Pacto Ético Electoral de forma extemporánea, como lo hicieron el Partido Democrático Verde y Podemos Perú. El proceso electoral cuenta con más de 13,000 candidatos aptos para las elecciones del domingo 4 de octubre de 2026. Los debates representan un reto logístico importante para el JNE debido al alto número de postulaciones inscritas a nivel nacional. Los debates oficiales del JNE se desarrollarán de manera descentralizada desde el martes 8 de setiembre hasta el sábado 19 de setiembre de 2026. Para la Municipalidad de Lima, la exposición de propuestas quedó programada para el domingo 21 y el lunes 22 de setiembre de 2026. El cronograma electoral establece que el debate regional del Callao se realizará el miércoles 16 de setiembre de 2026. Por su parte, la región de Lima Provincias tendrá dos jornadas de diálogo democrático programadas para el jueves 17 y el viernes 18 de setiembre de 2026.

articles.title: Gabinete se reúne en Consejo de Ministros desde las 6 p.m. en Palacio de Gobierno
articles.summary: El Consejo de Ministros que lidera Luis Galarreta sesiona hoy viernes 4 de setiembre desde las 6 p.m. en el Palacio de Gobierno de Lima. Esta cita de carácter ordinario reúne a los integrantes del gabinete para evaluar, entre otros puntos, la Política General del Gobierno.
articles.body_text: El Consejo de Ministros que lidera Luis Galarreta sesiona hoy viernes 4 de setiembre desde las 6 p.m. en el Palacio de Gobierno de Lima. Esta cita de carácter ordinario reúne a los integrantes del gabinete para evaluar, entre otros puntos, la Política General del Gobierno. Según la agenda oficial, esta iniciativa está comprendida en un proyecto de Decreto Supremo que aprueba esta política para el periodo 2026-2031 y busca “ordenar el Estado para recuperar la seguridad, destrabar el crecimiento y convertir las decisiones públicas en resultados, propuesto por la Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros”. Horas atrás, la presidenta Keiko Fujimori participó en actividades oficiales visitando el BAP Paita en la Base Naval del Callao, acompañada por los ministros Rafael Belaúnde y Marco Vinelli. La agenda de trabajo del Consejo de Ministros de este viernes incluye la presentación de un reporte sobre el cumplimiento del Plan Multisectorial ante Lluvias Intensas. La Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros expondrá las acciones preventivas frente a riesgos climáticos ejecutadas durante el primer semestre del año 2026. El Ministerio de la Mujer expondrá las respuestas del sector frente a los casos de violencia sexual contra menores en Condorcanqui. Por su parte, el Ministerio del Interior presentará el proyecto de ley que facilita el chatarreo de vehículos de la Policía Nacional. El gabinete analizará las solicitudes de prórroga del estado de emergencia para distritos de Chupaca y Huancayo afectados por movimientos sísmicos. Asimismo, el Ministerio de Defensa someterá a votación la resolución legislativa que autoriza el ingreso de personal militar extranjero al territorio nacional. El Ejecutivo espera el pronunciamiento de la Cámara de Diputados sobre la delegación de facultades legislativas solicitadas por un plazo de 120 días. La Comisión de Constitución se declaró en sesión permanente el 31 de agosto de 2026 para agilizar el estudio de esta propuesta. El pedido gubernamental comprende un total de 66 medidas para combatir el crimen organizado y dinamizar la economía de las pequeñas empresas. Actualmente el trámite se encuentra en la Comisión de Constitución y, según detalló el presidente del Senado, Miguel Torres (Fuerza Popular), espera la opinión de al menos otras ocho comisiones más.

articles.title: Keiko Fujimori pide rapidez al Congreso: “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”
articles.summary: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para recuperar el orden y enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada.
articles.body_text: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso de la República a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada. “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”, exclamó. Durante su visita a San Martín, Fujimori señaló que el Ejecutivo busca contar con las facultades especiales para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como “grupos hostiles”, “grupos terroristas”, como parte de las medidas planteadas para combatir la delincuencia organizada. “Invocamos al Congreso que puedan analizar este pedido de facultades de una manera rápida”, expresó. La mandataria también sostuvo que se necesita recuperar la capacidad operativa del servicio de inteligencia, que, según indicó, se ha visto limitada durante los últimos años. Otro de los puntos mencionados fue la necesidad de una actuación conjunta de las Fuerzas Armadas y la Policía Nacional. En ese sentido, señaló que ambas instituciones deben tener una mayor participación en el control de los establecimientos penitenciarios. Fujimori agregó que el pedido de facultades contempla un mecanismo para agilizar la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. “Necesitamos estas facultades para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como grupos hostiles, como grupos terroristas. Necesitamos fortalecer el servicio de inteligencia porque desde hace unos años no tiene capacidad operativa. Necesitamos que las Fuerzas Armadas y Policía Nacional actúen de manera conjunta y también tomen mayor control de los penales”, remarcó la mandataria.

articles.body_text: El Jurado Nacional de Elecciones (JNE) programó para el lunes 7 de setiembre un diálogo con representantes de organizaciones políticas. En dicha reunión, se decidirá si se permite la participación de postulantes al cargo de teniente alcalde en los debates para las Elecciones Regionales y Municipales 2026 como lo ha pedido Rafael López Aliaga. Carlos Vilela, director nacional de Educación del JNE, declaró a Canal N que iniciarán el diálogo para alcanzar consensos con las agrupaciones políticas. “Buscamos de manera democrática poder decidir si ellos quieren que participe, por ejemplo, el primer candidato de la lista que postulan (...) Posiblemente se decida lo mismo, o solo se decida como en elecciones presidenciales, que solo vayan los candidatos. Eso lo vamos a saber este día lunes”. Renovación Popular ha enviado un pedido escrito al JNE para permitir la presentación de Rafael López Aliaga en el debate para la Municipalidad de Lima a pesar de que es candidato a teniente alcalde y no a la alcaldía, ya que este puesto estaba ocupado por Luis Rubio, quien renunció a su postulación. La cita técnica del lunes 7 de setiembre de 2026 también servirá para definir las metodologías oficiales de los encuentros democráticos. Asimismo, los representantes partidarios elegirán a los profesionales independientes que asumirán las tareas de moderación en las transmisiones. “Nosotros invitamos a los representantes de Renovación Popular para que puedan asistir y ser partícipes del diálogo de esa propuesta”. articles.body_text: El Consejo de Ministros que lidera Luis Galarreta sesiona hoy viernes 4 de setiembre desde las 6 p.m. en el Palacio de Gobierno de Lima. Esta cita de carácter ordinario reúne a los integrantes del gabinete para evaluar, entre otros puntos, la Política General del Gobierno. Según la agenda oficial, esta iniciativa está comprendida en un proyecto de Decreto Supremo que aprueba esta política para el periodo 2026-2031 y busca “ordenar el Estado para recuperar la seguridad, destrabar el crecimiento y convertir las decisiones públicas en resultados, propuesto por la Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros”. Horas atrás, la presidenta Keiko Fujimori participó en actividades oficiales visitando el BAP Paita en la Base Naval del Callao, acompañada por los ministros Rafael Belaúnde y Marco Vinelli. La agenda de trabajo del Consejo de Ministros de este viernes incluye la presentación de un reporte sobre el cumplimiento del Plan Multisectorial ante Lluvias Intensas. La Presidencia del Consejo de Ministros expondrá las acciones preventivas frente a riesgos climáticos ejecutadas durante el primer semestre del año 2026. El Ministerio de la Mujer expondrá las respuestas del sector frente a los casos de violencia sexual contra menores en Condorcanqui. Por su parte, el Ministerio del Interior presentará el proyecto de ley que facilita el chatarreo de vehículos de la Policía Nacional. El gabinete analizará las solicitudes de prórroga del estado de emergencia para distritos de Chupaca y Huancayo afectados por movimientos sísmicos. Asimismo, el Ministerio de Defensa someterá a votación la resolución legislativa que autoriza el ingreso de personal militar extranjero al territorio nacional. El Ejecutivo espera el pronunciamiento de la Cámara de Diputados sobre la delegación de facultades legislativas solicitadas por un plazo de 120 días. La Comisión de Constitución se declaró en sesión permanente el 31 de agosto de 2026 para agilizar el estudio de esta propuesta. El pedido gubernamental comprende un total de 66 medidas para combatir el crimen organizado y dinamizar la economía de las pequeñas empresas. Actualmente el trámite se encuentra en la Comisión de Constitución y, según detalló el presidente del Senado, Miguel Torres (Fuerza Popular), espera la opinión de al menos otras ocho comisiones más.

articles.title: Keiko Fujimori pide rapidez al Congreso: “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”
articles.summary: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para recuperar el orden y enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada.
articles.body_text: La presidenta Keiko Fujimori invocó al Congreso de la República a analizar con rapidez el pedido de facultades legislativas presentado por el Poder Ejecutivo, al considerar que estas son necesarias para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada. “Para enfrentar a la criminalidad organizada necesitamos estas facultades (legislativas)”, exclamó. Durante su visita a San Martín, Fujimori señaló que el Ejecutivo busca contar con las facultades especiales para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como “grupos hostiles”, “grupos terroristas”, como parte de las medidas planteadas para combatir la delincuencia organizada. “Invocamos al Congreso que puedan analizar este pedido de facultades de una manera rápida”, expresó. La mandataria también sostuvo que se necesita recuperar la capacidad operativa del servicio de inteligencia, que, según indicó, se ha visto limitada durante los últimos años. Otro de los puntos mencionados fue la necesidad de una actuación conjunta de las Fuerzas Armadas y la Policía Nacional. En ese sentido, señaló que ambas instituciones deben tener una mayor participación en el control de los establecimientos penitenciarios. Fujimori agregó que el pedido de facultades contempla un mecanismo para agilizar la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. “Necesitamos estas facultades para determinar a las organizaciones criminales como grupos hostiles, como grupos terroristas. Necesitamos fortalecer el servicio de inteligencia porque desde hace unos años no tiene capacidad operativa. Necesitamos que las Fuerzas Armadas y Policía Nacional actúen de manera conjunta y también tomen mayor control de los penales”, remarcó la mandataria.

articles.title: Apple unveils its first foldable, the iPhone Duo | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Apple today introduced its first foldable device, named the iPhone Duo, at its "Surprise and Shine" iPhone event held in Cupertino. The phone is the first
articles.body_text: Apple today introduced its first foldable device, named the iPhone Duo, at its “Surprise and Shine” iPhone event held in Cupertino. The phone is the first marquee device launched under the company’s new CEO, John Ternus. Unlike early iterations of foldables, which looked like vertical slabs, Apple adopted a wider form factor that could aid in a better aspect ratio while watching videos when the device is unfolded. The unfolded display is a 7.6-inch Retina display, and the outer display is 5.4 inches. The company said that the new device was “Inspired by the versatility of iPad” and also showed how people can use it unfolded in a vertical mode. The inner display also features an “under-display” camera that can give users an all-screen feel. Apple said that it used a custom nanotexture finish to hide the crease and reduce glare. Most foldables still have a visible crease, but companies like Oppo have made strides towards an almost seamless phone. The company claimed that its hinge was created using grade 5 aluminum and over 100 special components for smooth opening and closing and durability. Notably, the device only has Touch ID, with Face ID missing. You can unlock the device using the Apple Watch, though. The device is powered by the new A20 Pro chip and C2 model, which allows for faster uploads. Just like last year’s iPhone Air, this particular model is eSIM-only. On the battery front, the company said that with the inner display, users can get 31 hours of video playback, and with the outer display, 44 hours of video playback. The phone features a 48-megapixel fusion main camera and a 48-megapixel ultrawide camera with 2x optical zoom. This dual camera setup skips a telephoto camera. Just like other foldables, users can take rear-camera selfies and look at previews on the outer display. It also has a Google Pixel-like feature that plays an animation on the outer display, which is useful when you are trying to get kids to focus while taking photos. There is also a smart-take feature that uses an on-device model and snaps an image when all subjects within the frame are posing. The company has also made iOS 27 adaptable to the new foldable; essential controls like Wi-Fi move to the side and dock on the home screen vertically oriented. Users can use apps in split screen and also pair the apps. If someone is using the phone vertically, they can pin a video on top and use other apps in the bottom half. One of the fascinating features is that users will be able to use the iPhone half-folded or even set it on a table. Apple noted that later this year, the device will also support Apple Pencil usage. The iPhone Duo is priced at $1,999 with 256GB storage and comes in two colors. Pre-orders for Apple’s new foldable begin on October 16, and the device will be available on October 23. Rivals like Samsung and Xiaomi have already launched their version of wide foldables before the Apple launch, give the iPhone Duo can spur demand for the form factor. According to analytics firm Counterpoint , foldables contribute to less than 2% of shipments in the overall smartphone market. However, Apple’s new phone could be an instant hit, as the analytics firm said the Duo could garner up to 25% market share by the end of the year.

articles.title: Apple CEO John Ternus says the best AI device is still the iPhone | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The company also argued that its on-device models offer consumers more privacy.
articles.body_text: The comments come as Ternus takes the reins at Apple from Tim Cook, who is now executive chairman, and offer a clear picture of how the company plans to compete in the AI era. Instead of building new hardware for AI, Apple wants to make the iPhone the central way consumers interact with the new technology. During his introduction at the Cupertino event, Ternus described the ideal AI device, or “intelligent personal hub,” as he called it. He said such a hub would have a broad understanding of a user’s personal context, always be with them, and have both a powerful processor capable of running AI models on-device and an internet connection to access models in the cloud. The device would also have a large display, high-quality cameras and microphones so it could see and hear the world around it, along with long battery life, Ternus continued. Plus, “you’d want it to be super easy to use without a big learning curve. And finally, you’d want it to work seamlessly with your other devices, apps, and services, so it feels like one integrated experience,” he said. “In other words, you would arrive at something remarkably familiar, because there’s no product in the world better designed to be your intelligent personal hub than iPhone,” Ternus said. “…Honestly, trust only goes so far when your data is no longer yours to control; that’s why Apple Intelligence runs on device whenever it can,” Ternus concluded.
